newsitem.title: UK: LCE coffee bounces on firm NY but ends below open.
newsitem.headline: LCE coffee bounces on firm NY but ends below open.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures tracked developments on the New York market on Thursday with most positions retaining their earlier weakness as origin selling continued to outweigh industry buying, traders said.

At the close the benchmark November contract stood $14 lower at $1,618 per tonne, just above its intraday low of $1,615. All nearby positions ended lower and volume totalled 3,905 lots. Traders said the London market was still under pressure as the November contract struggled to clear an overhead chart gap extending from $1,650 to $1,680.

While Far East players were seen as sellers on the London market, traders said sentiment on the robustas was still following the flow of New York, where long speculator liquidation and producer selling prevailed.
